I learned to fish here from my family, and protecting this village means caring for both our neighbors and the lake. Given the confirmed emergency, I commit to 15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000 directly to the clinic today, provided John, Kate, and Jack make the same commitment and Luke holds to zero.

This must remain a one-time exception. I also commit to 6 tons next month under the proposed 30-ton recovery cap, assuming the lake starts at 80 tons. Let’s share catch records and donation receipts afterward so everyone can see we followed through. John, will you join this agreement?
